plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bid your true value to maximize expected payoff. With v=$9, bidding $9 yields nonnegative expected surplus whenever you win and avoids overpaying. Tie probability is negligible given continuous draws and $0.1 increments. ]

[Second-price sealed-bid: truthful bidding is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit regardless of opponents. No prior history to learn from and values redraw each round. With private value $9, bid my true value so I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below $9, avoiding overpayment. Bids allowed in $0.1 increments; bid 9.0.]
